heroHeadline: Two Years Into the Sinaloa War: Guzmán Brothers Still at Large as Joaquín's Sentencing Slips to 2027
heroSubtitle: Oct 2019: Military retreats after Sinaloa Cartel overwhelms Culiacán. Jan 2023: Ovidio arrested amid mass urban firefight. Sep 2026: Two years after the La Mayiza–Chapitos war began, Iván and Alfredo Guzmán remain fugitives, Joaquín's sentencing-prep hearing slips to March 2027, and Sheinbaum seeks return of El Mayo's forfeited billions.
footerNote: Data sourced from SEDENA, SSPC, DOJ, Reuters, AP, BBC, Animal Político, InSight Crime, ACLED, La Jornada, Infobae, El Financiero, El Universal, NBC News, CNN, and Latin Times.
